title: Pre-Flight Checklist Completion Audit
dataSources: Pilot logbook (`flightlog:entry`), avionics telemetry (`avionics:telemetry`), flight-sim sessions (`flightsim:session`), pre-flight checklists (`preflight:check`).
app: Pilot and flight-sim telemetry — electronic logbooks (ForeFlight, LogTen Pro), Stratux / GDL90 avionics receivers, and Microsoft Flight Simulator / X-Plane SimConnect sessions — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=preflight:check
| stats sum(eval(if(status="done",1,0))) as done, count as total by flight_id
| eval pct=round(100*done/total,1), incomplete=if(done<total,1,0)
| where incomplete=1
description: Flags any flight where the pre-flight checklist was not fully completed, reinforcing a safety-critical habit.
value: Checklist discipline saves lives in aviation; an audit that catches skipped items strengthens the habit.
implementation: Log checklist completions into `index=personal`; flag flights with incomplete checklists.
visualization: Table of flights with incomplete pre-flight checklists.
grandmaExplanation: It flags any flight where you did not finish the pre-flight checklist, reinforcing a life-saving habit.
